name: UltraStar Play
tagline: Sing along and score your karaoke performance
description:
UltraStar Play is a free singing and karaoke game. Pick a song, grab a microphone, and see how closely you can match the pitch as the lyrics scroll by — just like the karaoke games you remember, but open source.

It also includes a built-in song editor, so you can time lyrics and pitch lines for your own tracks, and it works across desktop and mobile.
